rights_policy: Runtime resolves Wikimedia Commons extmetadata and accepts only CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public-domain photographs. Attribution records are saved beside the final media. No paid stock and no generated fantasy artwork are used.
content_policy: Explicitly label the Grey Man as Scottish folklore/legend. Do not present supernatural claims as proven fact. Separate Collie's documented historical account from later stories and from possible natural optical effects.
